name: Star Rating (Interactive)
summary: Native ascending radio group for choosing one integer rating from one through five with symmetric validation presentation.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native fieldset or equivalent radio-group boundary for one rating question.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible group question, preferably rendered as the fieldset legend.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the rating legend when one value is required.

anatomy.name: choices
anatomy.description: Fixed one-through-five visual row that preserves the native ascending DOM and keyboard order.

anatomy.name: choice
anatomy.description: Repeated touch-sized native label for one integer rating choice.

anatomy.name: radio
anatomy.description: Visually hidden native radio that retains focus, keyboard, validation, reset, and form-submission behavior.

anatomy.name: choiceLabel
anatomy.description: Localized text content that gives each native radio a readable one-through-five choice name while remaining visually hidden in the star treatment.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Decorative outline-or-fill star icon inside a choice label; icon source and path remain target-owned.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible question describing what the one-through-five choices rate.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Shared native form name applied to every radio in the group.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Currently selected integer rating; each radio retains its own corresponding native value.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected independently from the checked rating value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one native radio choice before submission and shows the standardized decorative marker once on the rating legend.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes every native radio choice unavailable.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: ID reference to supporting or validation feedback owned by the containing form composition.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Invalid rating presentation paired with aria-invalid and associated feedback.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Accepted rating presentation paired with associated feedback.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Rating requiring attention, paired with associated feedback.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default 28px star icon inside the existing touch-target token.

states.name: default
states.description: Available rating group with no pointer preview.

states.name: checked
states.description: Native selected value and the lower visual values shown as filled.

states.name: hover
states.description: Fine-pointer preview of a candidate value and lower values.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Visible focus indicator projected from the focused native radio onto its label.

states.name: error
states.description: Invalid rating group; visual treatment is reinforced by associated feedback and aria-invalid.

states.name: success

states.name: warning

states.name: errorFocusVisible

states.name: successFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Success choice with the matching outer validation ring.

states.name: warningFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Warning choice with the matching outer validation ring.

behavior.name: nativeSelection
behavior.description: Five native radios appear in ascending one-through-five DOM and visual order, share one name, and retain browser selection, arrow-key movement, validation, form reset, and submission semantics.

behavior.name: choiceLabels
behavior.description: Each choice contains localized text such as 4 stars; the decorative indicator does not replace that name and CSS-disabled output retains readable content.

behavior.name: validationSemantics
attributes: aria-describedby references visible feedback owned by the containing form composition
behavior.description: Error, Success, and Warning cover legend, choice outlines/fills, hover, and focus while associated text keeps validation from relying on color alone.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked establishes default checkedness in static HTML
one controlled group value in framework adapters
behavior.description: Static Web delegates live selection to the native named group; controlled adapters own one group value and update it through change rather than controlling five independent booleans.

accessibility: Use one native radio group with a visible legend or equivalent group label.
Give every radio a readable choice label such as 1 star or 5 stars.
Keep native and visual choice order ascending from one through five; do not use CSS direction reversal to reorder the radio group.
Preserve native keyboard selection, validation, form reset, and submission behavior.
Keep the native radio focusable and project focus-visible styling onto the touch-sized label.
Error uses aria-invalid and associated feedback; Success and Warning use associated feedback without aria-invalid, and hover/focus preserve the active validation family.
Static Web should use native checked default state; framework adapters should use either one controlled value plus change handling or an uncontrolled default, never five independent checked booleans.
Use Star Rating instead when the value is read-only.

web.notes: Native radio focus, checked, disabled, touch, and reduced-motion presentation is implemented in components/css/reviews.css.

shopify.notes: Submission transport and provider mapping remain outside the Star Input contract.
